---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a skill, agent, or improvement for the Market Opportunity Navigator
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the plugin doesn't support (or makes hard) today?
Describe the situation, not just the solution.

## Proposed skill / agent / idea

What you'd like to see. If it's a new skill or agent, sketch what it would do and
how a team would trigger it.

> Please keep the plugin's stance in mind: **this is not a strategy machine.**
> Proposals should keep the **human in the loop** — the plugin asks the
> cornerstone questions and gathers evidence, but the team makes every real
> decision. Features that would auto-aggregate scores, auto-pick a market, or
> otherwise decide *for* the team are out of scope by design.

## Which worksheet it serves

Where does this fit in the Market Opportunity Navigator?

- [ ] Worksheet 1 — Market Opportunity Set
- [ ] Worksheet 2 — Attractiveness Map
- [ ] Worksheet 3 — Agile Focus Strategy
- [ ] The longitudinal "breathing" loop (revisit)
- [ ] Cross-cutting / tooling (workflows, docs)

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you've thought about solving this, and why they fall short.

## Additional context

Links, references to the methodology, or examples.
